title: Admin test mode: jump to any lesson
changes: Added a 'Test as if at lesson N' control to the test-learner banner in Admin Test Mode, letting the admin reposition the journey (topic list, path-ahead widget, journey stats, daily route) to any lesson without needing to actually complete prior lessons.
Setting or clearing the lesson override now also clears any saved mid-session resume state, so jumping between lessons for testing doesn't get overridden by a stale in-progress mission.
The override is scoped to Admin Test Mode only and resets automatically when the admin exits test mode.
